• Salary, 
o Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $133,065 to $156,864 per annum + 17% superannuation
o Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $161,619 to $185,422 per annum + 17% superannuation
• Full-time
• 2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
• Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
The School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW has an opportunity for a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer to join a leading teaching and research team. This role will contribute to research and teaching in modern computing systems, with a focus on databases and related areas including human-centric databases, vector databases and high-dimensional databases for scientific discovery.

You will contribute to high-quality research outcomes, collaborative research initiatives and the School’s reputation in data management and database systems. At Lecturer level, you will develop your research profile and contribute to collaborative research and scholarly publications. At Senior Lecturer level, you will bring a strong track record of research leadership, competitive funding and supervision, while also contributing to curriculum development and educational leadership.

About You
You are an emerging or established academic with expertise in database systems and a passion for both research and teaching. You will have the ability to contribute to high-quality research outcomes while delivering engaging and innovative learning experiences for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will be developing your research profile and contributing to collaborative research activities, including competitive grant applications and scholarly publications, while also delivering high-quality teaching and supporting student learning across undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate an established research track record with evidence of research leadership, success in securing competitive funding, supervising HDR students, and making significant independent contributions to your field. You will also contribute to educational leadership through high-quality teaching, curriculum development, and mentoring students and colleagues.

You are an engaging educator with experience in delivering high-quality teaching and contributing to curriculum development. You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing academic environment and to build strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world-leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides an environment where academic expertise translates into real-world outcomes. The university is home to cutting-edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields.The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science and Bioinformatics, as well as combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
• A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments
• Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales)
• Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable)
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity & inclusion initiatives

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
• A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments
• Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others
• Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement
• Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
• Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership
• Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students
• Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships
• Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills
• Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives
• An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines
• Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training

To Apply: 
If you are an emerging academic looking to build your research and teaching profile, or an established academic seeking to further your career, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to high-quality research, deliver engaging teaching, and help shape the future direction of the School. We encourage you to click “Apply Now” and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.
Apply here: https://external-careers.jobs.unsw.edu.au/cw/en/job/541261/lecturersenior-lecturer-databases

If you have had any interruption in your career, you are encouraged to include a ROPE statement as part of your application. For information on ROPE please check: https://www.arc.gov.au/about-arc/program-policies/research-opportunity-and-performance-evidence-rope-statement 

Please note applications will not be accepted if sent to the contact listed below.

Contact: Eugene Aves - Talent Acquisition Consultant
E: eugene.aves@unsw.edu.au

Applications close: 11:50pm (Sydney time) on Tuesday 18 August 2026

As part of our recruitment process candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening, which may include reference checks, qualification verification, right-to-work verification, and criminal history screening where relevant to the role.

UNSW is committed to evolving a culture that embraces equity and supports a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can participate fairly, in a safe and respectful environment. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage applications from people of diverse gender, orientation, cultural & linguistic backgrounds, Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander background, people with disability and those with caring & family responsibilities. UNSW provides workplace adjustments for people with disability, and access to flexible work options for eligible staff. The University reserves the right not to proceed with any appointment.

Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst

Kogan People Solutions are delighted to be working with a local government powerhouse in Melbourne’s southeast, who wish to appoint a qualified skilled and experienced Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst.

The newly appointed Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst will coordinate the collection, maintenance, and reporting of Council’s GIS and spatial databases to ensure a "single source of truth" enhance spatial systems to support business units, optimize data integration for modelling, and deliver GIS training and support across the organization.

Location – Dandenong Vic

Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing

Salary – Offered in the range $95k to $105k plus superannuation, per annum 

Key Responsibilities of this exciting position include

System Development & Management

•	Platform Administration: Manage and enhance QGIS, IntraMaps, Mapbox, and related spatial systems to expand corporate utility.

•	Integration: Integrate GIS with corporate databases, the Property Information System, and Asset Management Systems to ensure data quality and system functionality.

•	Data Governance: Coordinate spatial data collection (including GPS data) and ensure compliance with external data agreements.
Business Analysis & Reporting

•	Data Interrogation: Utilize GIS and SQL query tools to extract, analyze, and interrogate spatial data for ad-hoc business requirements.

•	Reporting & Presentation: Create, map, and professionally present spatial and textual information for performance reporting and publications.

Customer Support & Vendor Management

•	Support & Training: Provide technical support, document user requests, prepare training materials, and deliver non-technical GIS training to internal staff.

•	Collaboration: Facilitate the bi-monthly GIS User Group and maintain effective working relationships with software vendors and contractors.
Continuous Improvement & Governance

•	Process Optimization: Review GIS workflows via process mapping and assist in developing industry-best-practice policies and procedures.

•	Change Management: Adhere to operational procedures for IT services, focusing on system testing and change management principles.

To be considered, we expect to be able to observe:

Education and Professional Memberships

•	Degree Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a relevant IT field.

•	Professional Association: Membership (or eligibility for membership) with a professional geospatial body requiring Continuing Professional Development (CPD), such as the Geospatial Council of Australia (formerly SSSI) or GITA.

Technical Skills & Experience

•	GIS & Database Admin: Proven experience developing, implementing, and administering GIS systems, SQL servers, and databases (Local Government experience preferred).

•	Data Querying: Demonstrated ability to interrogate complex spatial data using spatialized SQL queries.

•	Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, paired with the ability to communicate technical GIS concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Mandatory Licences & Pre-Employment Checks

The following credentials must be held (or obtained) prior to commencement and maintained throughout employment:

•	Current valid Victorian Driver’s Licence

•	Satisfactory National Police Check

•	Satisfactory Working with Children Check (WWCC)

Interested?

Please express interest to the recruiters Kogan People Solutions quoting reference # 6189-FS, using the facilities on this website.

We can only respond to shortlisted candidates and apologise in advance if we don’t respond to your application.

KOGAN PEOPLE SOLUTIONS – recruitment excellence

Membership and Systems Manager

Permanent part-time | 15 hours per week | Hybrid | Edgecliff, Sydney

PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy is recruiting a Membership and Systems Manager for a respected, long-established medical membership organisation based in Edgecliff.

This is a permanent part-time opportunity offering approximately 15 hours per week. The role will combine membership administration, member engagement, database and CRM management, reporting, operational coordination and support for the organisation’s systems transition.

About the role

The Membership and Systems Manager will support the effective delivery of membership services while maintaining accurate systems, records and reporting.

Key responsibilities include:

Managing membership enquiries and providing responsive member support
Maintaining accurate membership records and database information
Supporting membership applications, renewals and related administration
Producing membership reports and monitoring data quality
Coordinating member communications and engagement activities
Supporting the implementation and ongoing use of the organisation’s membership management system
Assisting with data migration, validation, reconciliation and process documentation
Liaising with internal stakeholders and external software or service providers
Identifying opportunities to improve membership and administrative processes
Providing general operational and administrative support as required
About you

You may currently work in a professional association, membership organisation, not-for-profit, medical college, education provider or another member-focused environment.

You will ideally bring:

Experience in membership services, association administration or customer service
Experience using a membership database, CRM or Association Management System
Strong data accuracy, reporting and record-management skills
Confidence communicating with members and senior stakeholders
Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently
Experience supporting a system implementation or data migration would be highly regarded
Experience with Microsoft Upbeat CRM would be particularly advantageous

This opportunity may suit an experienced professional seeking meaningful part-time work, balancing other professional or personal commitments, building a portfolio career or returning to the workforce.

Working arrangement
Permanent part-time employment
Approximately 15 hours per week
Usually worked across two days
Hybrid working arrangement
At least one day per week in the Edgecliff office is preferred
Salary

The salary range is:

$90,000–$105,000 per annum plus superannuation on a full-time equivalent basis.

As this role is approximately 0.4 FTE, the actual pro-rated salary is approximately:

$36,000–$42,000 per annum plus superannuation.

This equates to approximately $46–$54 per hour, depending on the final salary offered.

Eligibility

Applicants must have valid Australian working rights. Candidates holding temporary visas may be considered, subject to verification of their individual visa conditions and ongoing ability to perform the required hours.
How to apply

Please apply through Workforce Australia and include an up-to-date CV outlining your relevant membership, CRM, database, reporting and stakeholder-engagement experience.

For a confidential discussion, contact:

Pri Menon Gillett
Founder and Managing Director
PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy Pty Ltd
Email: pri@primarecruitmentandconsultancy.com.au
PRIMA welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including professionals returning to the workforce.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

· Work with business stakeholders to determine and document project high level business requirements (BRS) and obtain sign-off
· Work with business stakeholders and SME’s to elaborate requirements and obtain sign-off
· Set acceptance criteria for delivery cards
· Perform and own the data mapping activities
· Support business process design and system analysis
· Support Tech Lead as required on data modelling activities
· Transfer business knowledge to delivery and support teams
· Support Delivery Owner in prioritisation
· Support Developers / Testers / Analysts in delivery and support business stakeholders in UAT

Key Accountabilities:

· Support process of Business context and Requirements gathering
· Undertake technical analysis; define and document business logic; mapping and governance and success criteria
· Attend and contribute to agile ceremonies – Iteration Planning/Stand-up meetings/Retrospectives/Showcases
· Facilitate elaborations sessions; attend and facilitate other workshops as necessary
· Support development and testing team in understanding of requirements
· Contribute to Knowledge Transfer as required during and after delivery of project
· Perform other duties as necessary during delivery of project and as assigned by Project/Iteration manager
· Work collaboratively maintaining ongoing dialogue and relationships with Stakeholders as part of continued solution development and support.

Internal Relationships

· Develop and maintain positive working relationships with business customers.
· Work collaboratively with solution design peers and other technical peers.
· Work collaboratively with other internal areas (other parts of IT) as required.

External Relationships

· Work with external partners/vendors as required

Key Qualifications: (indicate whether mandatory or desired)
· Tertiary qualifications in IT, Business or associated field (Desired)

Key Experience: (minimum type and level of experience required to perform the role)

· Minimum 2 years’ experience in a business/system analyst role (Mandatory)
· Project lifecycle experience (mandatory)
· Track record of working in a fast-paced collaborative cross-functional environment (desired)
· Proficiency in working with distributed teams (desired)

Key Capabilities/Technical Competencies (skills, knowledge, technical or specialist capabilities)

· Ability to analyse customer requirements and provide innovative solutions or alternatives to meet those requirements.
· Strong SQL, Data Analysis and Data Profiling skills
· Familiarity with Data Modelling and Data Warehouse concepts
· A disciplined approach to planning, implementation and project execution
· Excellent presentation and communication skills
· Sound change management skills
· Ability for both ‘technical speak’ and ‘business speak’ and able to translate one to another.
· Business acumen and industry knowledge with a strong understanding of business processes and products
· Knowledge of Business Process Modelling and associated tools.
· Knowledge of a variety of database platforms, e.g. Netezza, Oracle, DB2, etc
· Knowledge of applications support and development
· Ability to cope with pressure, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes
· Good knowledge of Insurance domain (Desired)
· Experience with Cloud applications (Desired)

result.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and analytical ICT Business and Systems Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, analyse existing systems, and deliver technology solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and business performance.

You will act as the bridge between business needs and technical implementation by gathering requirements, documenting processes, and supporting the successful delivery of ICT projects.

Key Responsibilities

Consult with stakeholders to identify business needs and system requirements.
Analyse current business processes and recommend technology-driven improvements.
Gather, document and validate functional and technical requirements.
Prepare business requirement documents, process maps, user stories and functional specifications.
Work closely with software developers, project managers and third-party vendors to implement solutions.
Perform system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT) and quality assurance activities.
Assist with system integration, deployment and post-implementation support.
Analyse data and prepare reports to support business decision-making.
Develop user documentation, training materials and standard operating procedures.
Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation.
Monitor system performance and recommend ongoing improvements.
Ensure solutions comply with organisational policies, security requirements and industry best practices.

Skills & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline.
Minimum two years' experience as an ICT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst or similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
Knowledge of business process modelling techniques.
Experience with SQL, databases and reporting tools is desirable.
Understanding of SDLC, Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong documentation and presentation abilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Desirable
Experience with ERP, CRM or enterprise software platforms.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Power BI or business intelligence tools.
Exposure to cloud technologies and API integrations.
Experience within digital transformation or software implementation projects.
What We Offer

Competitive salary package of $80k - 95k

Career development and professional growth opportunities.
Collaborative and supportive work environment.
Opportunity to work on innovative ICT and digital transformation projects.
Flexible working arrangements where applicable.
